writeup: Woot has Maverick's HD-322 long-range wireless meat thermometer, single probe, new for $24.99 with a limit of 10 per order. Home Depot and Pensacola Hardware both sell the same model for $59.95. The receiver reads the probe from up to about 300 feet away, and the probe is rated to 662°F for grilling and roasting.
